capabilities: Initialize a vault with knowledge-base structure and templates (raw/wiki/schema, index, rules)
Write a managed instruction block to DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, or Codex global instruction files
Preview, back up, undo, and roll back changes to global instruction files
Disconnect the current vault binding from an agent entry file
Generate maintenance schedules and instructions for external schedulers and record run reports
disambiguation: Not an in-app AI chat or model client; it makes no network requests, calls no model APIs, and has no chat sidebar.
extras: Desktop only (Windows is the tested environment; other desktop systems need additional testing). Install is currently manual via GitHub Release pending marketplace review. Disabling or uninstalling the plugin does not remove the managed instruction blocks; use Disconnect first. README is mixed English and Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to register a vault as a knowledge base that external AI agents like Claude Code or Codex can discover and read and write directly.
